# Test fixtures

`lessons.json` and `examples.json` are copies of the draft lesson wording (pull request "lesson wording 1 to 4"). They are only here so `lessons.test.js` has real-shaped data to run on. The real files, `data/lessons.json` and `data/examples.json`, arrive with the wording pull request once the owner approves it; nothing in the app reads these copies.
